question: ‘Below the Poverty Line’ Census was done in the year _____ for the Eighth Five Year Plan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1992**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The census to determine the Below Poverty Line (BPL) population for the Eighth Five Year Plan was conducted in the year 1992.
 
• The Eighth Five Year Plan spanned from 1992 to 1997.
 
• The BPL census aimed to identify households living below the poverty line, which would be eligible for various welfare schemes.
 
• These surveys were crucial for effective targeting of poverty alleviation programs and ensuring that benefits reached the intended beneficiaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Below Poverty Line (BPL)**:

 
 
• BPL is an economic benchmark used by the government of India to indicate economic disadvantage and to identify individuals and households in need of government aid.
 
• The criteria for determining BPL status may include income, consumption, and other socio-economic factors.
 
 
 
• **Five Year Plans**:
 
 
• Five Year Plans were centralised and integrated national economic programs.
 
• They were first initiated in 1951 in India, inspired by the Soviet model of planned development.
 
 
 
• **Planning Commission**:
 
 
• The Planning Commission was an institution in the Government of India, which formulated India's Five-Year Plans.
 
• It was established in March 1950 and was dissolved in 2014, replaced by the NITI Aayog.
 
 
 
• **Poverty Alleviation Programs**:
 
 
• India has implemented various programs to alleviate poverty, including the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA), Public Distribution System (PDS), and Midday Meal Scheme.
 
• These programs aim to provide employment, food security, and nutrition to the impoverished sections of society.
